rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance – Annual General Adjustment capped at 5% (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: For fully covered units, the yearly rent increase (Annual General Adjustment, set by the Rent Board using a CPI formula) can never exceed 5%. Landlords with banked unused AGAs may still raise rent above 5% to reach the rent ceiling.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
citation_aliases: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Good Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.effective_date_note: Document gives no effective date for the cap; Measure BB passed in the November 2024 election.
rules.exemptions: Partially covered and exempt units (e.g., most single-family homes and condos, new construction with CO after 1980) have no rent ceiling. Government-owned/subsidized units are fully or partially covered depending on type and federal/state law.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully covered units: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single-family homes with tenancies begun before 1996; single-family homes with 5+ rooms rented individually.
rules.interaction: State law (Costa-Hawkins) limits local rent control on newer buildings and single-family homes/condos.
rules.conflict_note: Cutoff date taken from table: fully covered 'built before 1980' vs. new construction 'CO issued after 1980'; the exact 1980 boundary is not precisely stated.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family homes and condominiums mostly partially covered
tenancies in single-family homes begun before 1996

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance – just cause eviction and notice changes (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: Tenants in fully or partially covered units can be evicted only for just cause. A landlord cannot evict for nonpayment unless rent owed is at least one month of HUD Fair Market Rent, cannot evict for refusing to sign a new fixed-term lease, and must describe lease breaches and resulting harm in detail. Termination notices must refer the tenant to the Rent Board, and copies must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value
rules.key_value: Nonpayment eviction only if debt ≥ 1 month HUD Fair Market Rent
rules.effective_date_note: Document gives no general effective date; the Notice of Tenant Rights requirement applies to tenancies started on or after 2024-12-20.
rules.exemptions: Exempt units are outside the Ordinance (e.g., shared kitchen/bath where landlord lived there first).
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to fully and partially covered units, including new construction, most single-family homes and condos, and registered government-subsidized units.

unverifiable_exemptions: unit shared with landlord who lived there first
